item.tib: ma mo sbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi gter 'byung ud dpal dkar po'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces ma mo rbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi gter 'byung ud dpal dkar po'i phreng ba 'di yang rigs sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi thugs la nges shes 'khrungs pa'i don du rnam thar dag snang gis bskor nas gces bstus su bgyis pa/ kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis chu khyi hor zla lnga pa'i tshes la gnas chen phyugs mo dpal ri'i mdun zhol dga' ldan gling gi pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i yang rtser brtsams pa/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur pa'i smon lam dang bcas (i)//
